asterisk_log.title: Asterisk
asterisk_log.description: Log files written by the Asterisk PBX framework (e.g. /var/log/asterisk/full and messages) and saved console output.

callid.description: The call identifier that ties together the messages for a single call

context.description: The dialplan context of a message logged by the Log() application

exten.description: The dialplan extension of a message logged by the Log() application

priority.description: The dialplan priority of a message logged by the Log() application

tid.description: The ID of the thread that logged the message
